item.title: Suspect found dead after man, woman shot in Baldwin Park Target parking lot
item.description: A man accused of shooting two people in a Target parking lot in Baldwin Park died by suicide overnight, according to police.

item.title: Mother and pre-teen cheerleader daughter killed in apparent murder-suicide in Las Vegas, police say
item.description: A mother shot and killed her pre-teen cheerleader daughter in a Las Vegas hotel room over the weekend, before turning the gun on herself and taking her own life, according to police.

item.title: Opening statements held in trial of Georgia high school shooting suspect's father
item.description: The trial has started for a man whose teenage son is accused of killing two students and two teachers at a Georgia high school in 2024.

item.title: Nurses at Providence Cedars-Sinai in Tarzana go on strike
item.description: Registered nurses and other licensed medical professionals at Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana Medical Center began a five-day strike Monday.

item.title: Taylor Swift concert attack plot leads to terrorism charges against 21-year-old man
item.description: Austrian public prosecutors filed terrorism-related charges Monday against a 21-year-old defendant who they say planned to carry out an attack on one of superstar singer Taylor Swift's concerts in Vienna in August 2024.

item.title: Logan Paul's Pikachu Illustrator Pokémon card sells for record $16.5M
item.description: On Monday, the Pikachu Illustrator card sold at Goldin Auctions after 41 days of bidding.

item.title: TSA works without pay during partial U.S. government shutdown
item.description: TSA agents are among those working without pay during the latest partial government shutdown.

item.title: Storm timeline: Two more storms to move through SoCal after heavy rainfall Monday
item.description: After a powerful storm system Monday drenched Southern California with heavy rain and dumped snow on the mountains, two more storms will move through this week.

item.title: US surfer Kurt Van Dyke found murdered in Costa Rica, authorities say
item.description: Kurt Van Dyke, a U.S. surfer from Santa Cruz, was found strangled and stabbed multiple times inside his apartment in a small surf town in Costa Rica.

item.title: Fairfax businesses flood as owners say city's pre‑positioned equipment failed to keep them dry
item.description: Business owners dealing with significant flooding damage say they are disappointed that pre-positioned city trucks intended to act as vacuums didn't keep them dry.
